name: Gabon
summary_text: Gabon demands real caution — and on a surprising positive trajectory: after briefly criminalising same-sex intimacy in 2019, it decriminalised in 2020, and in November 2024 voters ratified a new constitution that rejected calls to criminalise homosexuality. No LGR; social conservatism; but the constitutional debate is now public and the pro-criminalisation side lost.

sources.title: Gabon | Outright International
sources.claim_summary: Outright International country overview (updated March 2026): Gabon criminalised same-sex intimacy in 2019 (up to 6 months and a large fine), then decriminalised in 2020 after Senate approval of repeal - sharply dividing opinion. The November 2024 constitution codified the right to respect for private life (Article 18) but retained Article 169 limiting marriage to opposite-sex couples. No legal gender recognition.

sources.title: Gabon: New constitution won't criminalize homosexuality
sources.claim_summary: Erasing 76 Crimes (Nov 2024): Gabon's new constitution (ratified by referendum with 90%+ approval) rejected appeals to criminalise homosexuality and included protections for LGBT+ rights, while codifying a marriage definition excluding same-sex couples; civil society had pushed for criminalisation during the drafting under the transitional military regime.

sources.title: Gabon - United States Department of State
sources.claim_summary: US State Department 2019 Human Rights Report for Gabon: official assessment covering the year the new penal code criminalised same-sex conduct - documents the legal change and societal discrimination.

sources.title: Gabon criminalized homosexuality & two men have already been arrested - LGBTQ Nation
sources.claim_summary: LGBTQ Nation (Dec 2019): Gabon criminalised homosexuality (up to 6 months' prison, ~$8,500 fine) - a country that never had a colonial ban; two men already arrested and had to bribe police to be released; activist Davis Mac-Iyalla: the law 'sent the LGBT community underground and created harassment'.

sources.title: Gabon formally decriminalizes homosexuality
sources.claim_summary: Washington Blade (July 2020): Gabon formally decriminalised homosexuality - the National Assembly overturned the 2019 ban, restoring the pre-2019 status where same-sex conduct was not criminal.

sources.title: Homosexualité : Le nouveau Code pénal sanctionne la pratique | Gabonreview.com | Actualité du Gabon |
sources.claim_summary: Gabon Review (Oct 2019, in French): analysis of the new penal code (law 042/2018 of 5 July 2019) - Article 402 classifies 'sexual relations between people of the same sex' under 'sexual assaults and attacks on morals'; recalls the 2013 controversy when two men celebrating a union were arrested and released because no law then criminalised adults.
